text:
The tightening of Hong Kong’s securities regulations – in the wake of property developer Evergrande’s liquidation and unrelated IPO frauds – has resulted in more delistings than resumptions for the first time in three years, according to a report by accountants Grant Thornton.
Hong Kong saw 35 delistings in the 12 months to August this year but only 21 resum

会计师事务所致同的一份报告显示，在房地产开发商恒大清盘及无关的IPO欺诈事件之后，香港收紧证券监管，导致退市数量三年来首次超过复牌数量。
截至今年8月的12个月内，香港共有35家公司退市，但仅有21家复牌……
